description: Additional country-specific modeled company duties, authored from fictional role and skill context. Not observed employee work or external occupational facts.

templates.title: Strategy options and business cases
duties: Analyze business performance and market scenarios to identify strategic choices.
Compare the financial and operational implications of proposed growth or service changes.
Prepare evidence-based recommendations and communicate assumptions to stakeholders.
Track agreed strategic initiatives and investigate deviations from their intended outcomes.
exclusions: No transaction execution, investment advice or final strategy approval.
Not routine reporting alone or a general management position.

templates.title: Business process and service coordination
duties: Map internal service workflows and identify delays, handoff issues and rework.
Coordinate operational improvement tasks and maintain process documentation.
Monitor service volumes and delivery measures, investigating exceptions with responsible teams.
Recommend practical process changes and check implementation progress.
exclusions: No general-manager authority or automatic ownership of budgets and staffing.
Not primarily sales analysis, software engineering or external management consulting.

templates.title: Business service sales
duties: Identify prospective business customers and clarify their service needs.
Present relevant service proposals and coordinate technical input from delivery specialists.
Negotiate commercial terms within approved limits and progress opportunities toward signed agreements.
Maintain opportunity records and hand agreed requirements to delivery teams.
exclusions: No authority to approve exceptional pricing or contractual risk independently.
Not post-sale support only, investment sales or a technical engineering role.

templates.title: Sales process and pipeline support
duties: Maintain consistent opportunity stages, account records and sales reporting definitions.
Review pipeline completeness, conversion patterns and forecast inputs with sales teams.
Coordinate sales-process improvements and explain changes to account teams.
Prepare operational sales reports and investigate data-quality exceptions.
exclusions: No individual prospecting, closing quota or ownership of customer support.
Not assumed to perform predictive modeling, market research or pricing approval.

templates.title: AI solution architecture
duties: Translate service requirements into an AI application design with clear system and data interfaces.
Compare model and integration options against quality, latency, cost and operational constraints.
Define evaluation criteria and review prototype results with engineering and data teams.
Document deployment dependencies, human oversight and operational monitoring requirements.
exclusions: Not a research scientist or a general enterprise/network architect by title alone.
No automatic security certification, model safety guarantee or production approval.

templates.title: Business process and service coordination
duties: Map internal service workflows and identify delays, handoff issues and rework.
Coordinate operational improvement tasks and maintain process documentation.
Monitor service volumes and delivery measures, investigating exceptions with responsible teams.
Recommend practical process changes and check implementation progress.
exclusions: No general-manager authority or automatic ownership of budgets and staffing.
Not primarily sales analysis, software engineering or external management consulting.

templates.title: Client service operations
duties: Coordinate client service requests, delivery schedules and internal handoffs.
Track service commitments and escalate unresolved delivery issues to accountable teams.
Maintain client delivery records and communicate progress and exceptions.
Review recurring service issues and recommend workflow improvements.
exclusions: No prospecting, sales quota, contract negotiation or revenue ownership is assumed.
Not investment/client-account advice or technical system engineering.

templates.title: Corporate development and transactions
duties: Screen acquisition opportunities against the company strategy.
Develop valuation and transaction analyses using explicit assumptions.
Coordinate financial and commercial due diligence and summarize transaction risks.
exclusions: Not generic management consulting or routine operations analysis.
No investment recommendation, transaction approval or occupational match is implied.

templates.title: Workforce analysis and decision support
duties: Validate workforce measures, definitions and reporting populations with HR stakeholders.
Analyze workforce trends and differences across roles, locations and periods using appropriate statistical methods.
Explain findings and limitations to HR leaders and identify questions needing further evidence.
Maintain reproducible workforce analyses with privacy-aware aggregation and access controls.
exclusions: No automated hiring, dismissal or individual employee scoring.
Predictive modeling, production data science and causal impact estimation are not assumed requirements.

templates.title: Customer adoption and support
duties: Guide customer onboarding and product adoption.
Coordinate support issues and explain available product capabilities.
Monitor customer feedback and communicate adoption obstacles to product teams.
exclusions: No sales quota, prospecting, closing or revenue ownership is assumed.
Not automatically mapped to service sales representatives.

templates.title: Talent development and succession coordination
duties: Coordinate talent reviews and document development needs with managers and HR partners.
Help employees and managers translate development needs into practical learning and career plans.
Maintain succession and internal-mobility information using agreed criteria.
Monitor participation and follow-up actions, reporting gaps in development support.
exclusions: No unilateral promotion, succession appointment or employment decisions.
Not recruitment sourcing, compensation design, or ownership of all HR strategy.
